metrics.blurb: Of the k account-days alerted on a day, the share that carry a laundering label.
metrics.label: precision@k

metrics.blurb: Of every positive account-day in the window, the share that reached the daily top k.
metrics.label: recall@k

metrics.blurb: recall@k divided by the attainable ceiling at the same budget.
metrics.label: recall_efficiency@k

metrics.blurb: A ring counts as caught if ANY of its account-days reaches the top k that day.
metrics.label: ring_recall@k

note: Every number here is read from a committed artifact under aml-platform/results_archive/. Nothing is typed in by hand, and no superseded or retracted value is included.

canonical.canonical_Medium_gbdt: HI-Medium GBDT under the sort; reproduces the pre-2026-09-12 lineage exactly.
canonical.canonical_Medium_gbdt_replica: an independent rerun of canonical_Medium_gbdt on the same machine: identical training-matrix hash, prediction hash and every metric. It is the evidence that the canonical Medium result is reproducible, so it is held to the same provenance standard.
canonical.large_sorted_lgbm: HI-Large, LightGBM, 3 seeds, ORDER BY txn_id, byte-identical training matrices.
canonical.leaksweep2_Small: leak sweep under the (side, day) stratified placebo.

superseded.large_eval2_lgbm: as above; a re-evaluation of the same unsorted scores.
superseded.large_eval3_lgbm: as above; the many-to-many ring-membership re-evaluation, still over unsorted fits.
superseded.large_eval_lgbm: evaluated scores from fits made with an undetermined training row order (pre-ORDER BY). Superseded by large_sorted_lgbm.
superseded.large_final_lgbm: the unsorted HI-Large fits themselves. code_git_sha unknown.
superseded.leaksweep_Small: leak sweep under the GLOBAL placebo permutation, superseded by leaksweep2_Small.
superseded.models3_Medium: fitted during the window when load_train_xy did not sort. Reproduced neither the older lineage nor the canonical one.
superseded.splits3_Medium: split manifest from the models3_Medium run.

supporting.ensemble_curve_Medium: the single-ordering ensemble-size curve. Superseded for the DECISION by typology_Medium's 12-ordering curve, but its per-seed values are still cited.
supporting.eval_Medium: the eight-seed HI-Medium evaluation. Backs the headline precision@50, the eight-seed mean/range and the published figure.
supporting.infl_eval_naive: split-inflation: evaluation of the naive fits.
supporting.infl_eval_ring-aware: split-inflation: evaluation of the ring-aware fits. Also the manifest the small replay bundle is verified against.
supporting.infl_fit_naive: split-inflation: the naive-protocol fits, five seeds.
supporting.infl_fit_ring-aware: split-inflation: the ring-aware fits, five seeds.
supporting.infl_splits_naive_Small: the naive split used by the inflation experiment.
supporting.infl_splits_ring-aware_Small: the ring-aware split used by the inflation experiment.
supporting.large_splits: the HI-Large split, built on the VM.
supporting.models_Medium: the HI-Medium fits behind eval_Medium. Reproduced exactly by canonical_Medium_gbdt, which is why that one is canonical and this one is its origin.
supporting.reconcile_Medium: label reconciliation on HI-Medium. Source of row and positive counts.
supporting.reconcile_Small: label reconciliation on HI-Small. Source of row and positive counts.
supporting.stability_Medium: seed-stability sweep on HI-Medium. Source of the spread figures in RESULTS_metric_stability.md.
supporting.typology_Medium: per-typology results on HI-Medium, and the corrected 12-ordering ensemble curve the decision table is generated from.
